verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas engine source is public on GitHub (playcanvas/engine), which describes it as an open-source engine. A runtime probe confirms the engine is MIT-licensed, the Editor MCP server's source is public under the official org, and community comments independently call it open source. missing for 10: evidence that the browser-based Editor itself is open source (it appears cloud-hosted), and first-party docs that explicitly state the license terms rather than relying on a probe.
